reason: The only named individual characters in this passage are Joshua (יְהוֹשֻׁעַ), Sihon (סִיחוֹן), Og (עוֹג), and Moses (מֹשֶׁה). Joshua is the military commander of Israel; Sihon is the king of Heshbon; Og is the king of Bashan; and Moses is referenced as the great lawgiver whom God commanded. All other figures are referenced collectively or generically (the kings, the Gibeonites, the Hivites, the elders of the congregation, the men of Israel, etc.) without individual names. Every named character holds a position of leadership.
